title: Tele Sena: Independence and Weekly 121 draw results
seoTitle: Tele Sena Results: Independence and Weekly 121
subtitle: SBT announces the winning numbers and the total prizes distributed during the week
excerpt: This Sunday (13), SBT revealed the numbers for the 2026 Independence Tele Sena and Weekly Tele Sena No. 121, totaling over two million reais in prizes.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
SBT broadcasted, this Sunday (13), the results of the 2026 Independence Tele Sena and Weekly Tele Sena No. 121, generating great interest from bettors who follow the live drawings.

2026 Independence tele sena result

The fifth drawing of the Independence campaign featured the numbers 35, 52, 09, 20, 54, 08, 34, 03, 24, 18, 37, and 55, along with the Lucky Number 021,672. The broadcast was made by SBT, the network that airs the product from Liderança Capitalização, hosted by Luís Ricardo.

Weekly tele sena no. 121 and its prizes

Weekly Tele Sena No. 121 put R$ 200,000 on the line in the first round and R$ 1 million in the second. The Weekly Spin offered prizes ranging from R$ 100 to R$ 1,000. Adding it all up, the total distributed throughout the week exceeded R$ 2 million.

How to buy the tele sena online

Those interested can purchase the Tele Sena on the product's official website using a credit card. Titles bought online are linked to the buyer's registration and become available in the "My Tele Senas" area.

Redemption of prizes

Payment of the amounts can be made on the official website or at accredited agencies, upon presentation of the physical title or digital version and an identification document. The legitimacy of the payment is confirmed after data checking.

Other prize categories

In addition to the main rounds, the campaign offers boards such as Most Points (prize of up to R$ 600,000), Fewest Points (up to R$ 500,000), and Almost There (up to R$ 500,000). The Independence drawings are held weekly on Sundays since August 16, totaling five draws to date.

With information from Diário do Nordeste, SpaceMoney.
